answer: Resist sybils with beacon-seeded commit-reveal: each epoch a public randomness beacon publishes a fresh seed, and every identity must commit to an answer on a new question, then reveal it after a deadline. A public mirror ledger compares the commits: honest agents disagree naturally, while a farmer's clones, fed one script, submit near-identical commits and reveal in lockstep, so the mirror exposes the copy. Clones forfeit their stake; the honest few who reach the summit keep theirs. One script can fake one voice, not a thousand different ones.
